description: Servizio programmato del Trasporto Pubblico Regione Piemonte (TPL) - GTFS Autobus is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Piemonte. Dati relativi al servizio programmato di trasporto pubblico di linea con autobus contribuito dalla Regione Piemonte, con dettaglio delle linee, nodi-fermata, corse, orari, calendario di effettuazione, più eventuali polilinee dei percorsi, in formato GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification). Attualmente tale file.zip non contiene i dati del servizio urbano di Torino e di altri contratti minori. Coverage: Regione Piemonte. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Piemonte. Its tags are agenzia, amp, autobus, autolinee, fermata. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
